page_title: AUG 0-1 STU | Augsburg v Stuttgart 10/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+5' That's a clear yellow card. Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) goes into the book.
90+4' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Augsburg out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.

90+1' What a wasted opportunity by Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Tomas Koubek makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
88' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

87' Tomas Koubek was forced into action to thwart Silas (VfB Stuttgart). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
85' The referee allows time for a substitution. Phillip Tietz will be replaced by Dion Beljo (Augsburg).
84' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Deniz Undav.
84' A substitution has been made. Enzo Millot is replaced by Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart).
82' Iago (Augsburg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
79' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 27:73.
76' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
75' Substitution. Tim Breithaupt leaves the pitch and is replaced by Arne Engels (Augsburg).
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Sven Michel (Augsburg) is replacing Niklas Dorsch.
72' Yellow card. Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
71' Here is a change. Chris Fuhrich is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart).
71' It will be a substitution. Silas (VfB Stuttgart) is ready to enter the pitch as Jamie Leweling walks off.
69' Patrick Ittrich blows the whistle, Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) is penalised for a foul.
65' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the top left corner and forces a good save out of Tomas Koubek.
63' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
62' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
60' Great teamplay by Stuttgart as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
58' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
57' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Jamie Leweling with a fine lofted pass.
55' The linesman signals that Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
53' 0:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
52' A cross from a corner kick by Stuttgart is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

52' What a wasted opportunity by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Tomas Koubek makes an astonishing save to thwart him. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
50' Augsburg will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
48' 0 - 1 Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
47' Iago (Augsburg) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
47' Arne Maier (Augsburg) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just over the bar.
45+1' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' Augsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
42' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
41' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
38' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
36' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) blows a great chance. He unleashes a shot from inside the box, but the effort rattles the left post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
32' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
32' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Ruben Vargas limps off the pitch to be replaced by Arne Maier (Augsburg).
31' The game is interrupted now, Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Tomas Koubek acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save!
30' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) brings his opponent down. Patrick Ittrich has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
25' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
25' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
24' A free kick on the edge of the box for Augsburg. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
23' Augsburg will take a free kick from near the half-way line.
20' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
18' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) finds Leonidas Stergiou with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
15' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is able to continue to play.
14' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
13' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
12' Iago (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) tries to find Jamie Leweling with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
8' Stuttgart seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
3' The resulting corner from Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
2' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the left post.
